newsitem.title: UK: COURT TO RULE ON CAMELOT 49'S CASE MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: COURT TO RULE ON CAMELOT 49'S CASE MONDAY.

text.p: A consortium of British bookmakers Coral, Ladbroke and William Hill said on Tuesday a British court would rule next Monday on a private prosecution case brought by National Lottery operator Camelot.
The three bookmakers set up a daily betting game -- 49's -- in December in an attempt to win back business from the popular national lottery and keep marginal shops open.
The companies say the 49's game is a fixed odds bet and legal. But Camelot argues the game constitutes an illegal lottery and has pursued legal action.
The companies said the judge decided to reserve judgment "because of the importance of the case" and to make a ruling on Monday August 18.
In the 49's game, customers can bet on between one and five numbers in a daily draw.
